div.head: Af 8.1
div.ab: Gif heo leng libbe ðonne se þe heo útlædde, nage heo his yrfes awuht.
Gif hio leng libbe ðonne se ðe hie utlædde, nage hio his ierfes owiht.
Si ipsa diutius uiuat quam qui eam abduxit, nichil de pecunia eius habeat.
Gif hio leng libbe ðonne se ðe hie utlædde, nage hio his ierfes owiht.
If she outlives the man who took her out, she does not own any of his inheritance.
If she lives longer than he who abducted her, she shall inherit nothing of his property.
If she outlives him who brought her out, she is to have nothing of his inheritance.
Falls sie länger lebt als er, der sie entführt hat, erhalte sie nichts von seinem Erbe.
If she lives longer than he who abducted her, let her receive nothing of his estate.
